issue_context.title: Single-fire Callbacks report as initially locked
issue_context.body:
http://jsfiddle.net/2d9gwd2c/

Note how the "once" flag breaks `.locked()`.

In code, this assertion fails:

``` js
equal( jQuery.Callbacks("once").locked(), false );
```
